newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Hanbo Steel to delay receivership filing.
newsitem.headline: Hanbo Steel to delay receivership filing.

text.p: Hanbo Steel Corp, a unit of South Korea's Hanbo Group, said on Friday it would delay filing for court receivership until Monday in order to finalise paperwork.
Hanbo Group chairman Chung Bo-keun had earlier said it would submit the court application on Friday.
"The application will be filed on Monday," said group spokesman Yang Jin-soo.

Hanbo Steel defaulted on payment of more than five billion won in promissory notes on Thursday after facing financial trouble stemming from excessive facilitities investment, officials from the company's creditor banks said.
Hanbo officials said the steel firm was saddled with debts totalling 5.7 trillion won.
